whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Baithke bihari cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.5★ reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature Bihari dishes menu, aur cafe timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/baithkebihari

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Baithke Bihari Cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and your menu showcase right on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur actual cafe photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
